sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that they are owner of the houses/shops in question and they are duly paying municipal taxes to Nagar Nigam, Gorakhpur.
The basis on which the petitioners claim title over the aforesaid houses has been disclosed in paragraph no. 4 of the writ petition.
It is submitted that the respondent-Authorities are compelling the petitioners to execute sale deeds in their favour for 'Heritage Corridor Project' without acquisition and payment of compensation.
3. Learned Standing Counsel has placed on record the written instructions received from Executive Engineer, Constructions Division-II, PWD, Gorakhpur.

The stand taken in paragraph no.4 of the written instructions is that, although, the petitioners claim title on basis of various sale deeds but the sale deeds only mention house numbers and no arazi numbers and, therefore, the respondents are finding it difficult to obtain sale deeds from the petitioners.

At the same time, it is admitted that the land is required for the 'Heritage Corridor Project'.
4.

In case the respondents are not clear about the title of the petitioners and are not ready to obtain sale deeds from them, they also cannot take possession of the subject land for executing the project unless the same is acquired through compulsory acquisition.
5. Having regard to the said undisputed legal position, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the respondents would proceed in the matter strictly in accordance with law and, in case, subject land is required by the respondent-Authorities, they would either acquire title over it through compulsory acquisition or through any other mode recognized under law.
